name: Endura, Scepter of Ignition: [REST] remove an enlighten counter, deal 1 damage to target unit
notes: Endura is REGALIA -- seeded directly onto myField. Its prereq requires the champion to already have an enlighten counter (GeneratedMacroCode.php ~6147-6172), patched directly via Counters. Same Scry-the-Skies warm-up + direct Activate:0 click as crystal-of-empowerment-banish-level (this ability's own effect isn't 'until end of turn', but the same 'field item isn't reliably clickable as the literal first action of a fresh turn' caution is reused). A Dungeon Guide on the opponent's field is the damage target; its Damage=1 and the champion's enlighten counter dropping to 0 together prove the effect.

rulesClauses: [REST], Remove an enlighten counter from your champion: Deal 1 damage to target unit.
